_note: Copy to private/config/sources.json. getro_boards: investor job boards hosted on Getro (public sitemap + job pages, D50-D51, D57). a16z_boards: a16z-style portfolio boards (public sitemap + company pages, D61). Boards that need a sign-in are not supported. serper: search-engine discovery (D52, D66, D69); each title is searched on each readable job-board site in any of the places, once every every_days. core_titles are searched every run; rotating_titles take turns with what is left of max_credits_per_run, each run continuing where the last stopped; one search page = one credit; needs SERPER_API_KEY in private/.env. form_d: SEC Form D filings (Phase 6, D70-D71); the SEC requires a contact email in every request, kept only here. funding_news: TechCrunch funding RSS feeds (every run) and Serper news searches (every serper.every_days, daily since D113; 1 credit each; each search reads the time since the last good one) (D72, D113); serper.national_queries are searched too, with no city in them, and a raise whose story doesn't place an untracked company in NYC gets one short AI NYC check, at most nyc_checks_per_run companies a run (D117); headlines older than max_age_days are logged but not counted, and several reports of one round stay one round (D77).

queries: "New York" startup raises "Series C" OR "Series D"
